status.en: 8 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 47% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Fallujah.
status.nb: 8 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 47 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Fallujah.

summary.en: Iraqi forces are exploring Canadian drone technology for border security and senior generals are inspecting army posture in Kirkuk, while an armed faction warned it would respond forcefully if the US uses Iraqi airspace against Iran. A bomb attack targeted a government employee in Dhi Qar and a Turkish diplomat was shot dead in Erbil. A vessel caught fire off Iraq's coast, raising Gulf security concerns. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske styrker utforsker kanadisk droneteknologi for grensekontroll, og høytstående generaler inspiserer hærenes stilling i Kirkuk, mens en væpnet fraksjon advarte om at den vil svare kraftig dersom USA bruker irakisk luftrom mot Iran. Et bombeangrep rettet seg mot en regjeringsansatt i Dhi Qar, og en tyrkisk diplomat ble skutt død i Erbil. Et fartøy tok fyr utenfor Iraks kyst, noe som øker sikkerhetsbekymringene i Persiabukta. UCDP registrerte 396 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
